text:
alex: Quick sync — BankX POC: BYO HSM + Redwood proxy. They want customer-managed keys, 7-day rotation window, and confirmation on network/firewall + any SLA delta. tagging @maria_se and @jordan_sec for presales/security :eyes:
maria_se: Thanks. High level checklist: 1) SOW for proxy + onboarding 2) Network runbook (ports/ips) 3) Attestation / HSM vendor proof 4) Pricing delta for BYO vs managed keys. I can draft SOW if we agree scope.
jordan_sec: Heads up — security questionnaire will ask about rotation granularity and KMS audit logs. Our default for BYO-HSM customer-managed keys is to allow customer rotation cadence, but 7-day rotation is an edgecase for them? Need business justification (regulatory?) before security OKs exception. Also we'll need an HSM attestation report (e.g., AWS CloudHSM cert or vendor attest).
sam_sre: From infra side we'll need these firewall rules and a peering checklist. Minimal snippet below — please confirm with customer's infra: ```allow outbound TCP 443 to 34.210.12.45 (proxy) allow inbound TCP 22 from bankx-bastion CIDR 10.8.0.0/24``` Also note: BYO traffic increases egress in proxy layer; budget for throughput if they plan heavy token volume.
alex: @eve_bankx can you confirm whether the rotation requirement is regulatory (e.g., PCI/FFIEC) or an internal ops cadence? That changes how we model key escrow + emergency rotation.
eve_bankx: It's regulatory — internal compliance wants 7-day rotation for keys wrapping corp secrets. They can provide regulatory cite. Also they will require HSM attestation and a quarterly rotation audit.
maria_se: OK — if regulatory, security will likely accept 7-day but we need SOW clause for key-handling responsibilities + SLA on rotation success windows. Pricing note: BYO-HSM proxy add-on ~ $5-8k/mo depending on throughput and replication. I can get a firm number after we size RPS.
jordan_sec: Add to sec checklist: (a) KMS audit log retention (b) HSM attestation (c) access control matrix for key admin (d) incident response runbook for key compromise. We'll need customer signoff on shared responsibilities in SOW.
alex: Can we get a quick estimate for a 100 reqs/sec baseline? Also timeline for a POC (we propose 2 weeks staging + 2 weeks validation).
sam_sre: For 100 rps baseline, proxy + small burst capacity is fine on a single dedicated pool. Cost impact: expect +15-25% unit cost due to proxy overhead. POC timeline: we can do infra prep in 3 business days after network permissions.
maria_se: I'll draft SOW with milestone: Week0: network prep & attest collection, Week1: deploy proxy + key handshake, Week2: integration tests, Week3: validation & handoff. I'll attach a pricing appendix with two SKUs (POC mode flat fee, and prod monthly commit).
eve_bankx: We have an internal dev lead (DevOps: "luis@bankx.com") who will handle the firewall changes. Luis will also provide HSM vendor certs.
deploy-bot: Ticket created: POC-9873 — owner: maria_se, infra: sam_sre, security review queued (jordan_sec).
alex: Action items: (1) Maria — SOW draft by EOD tomorrow (2) Sam — confirm firewall IPs + draft runbook (3) Jordan — security checklist + list of mandatory questionnaire answers. I'll send quote once SOW draft is in. :thumbsup:
maria_se: Got it, will share draft. Also asking pricing ops to confirm exact $ delta for 100 rps.
jordan_sec: I'll pre-fill the security questionnaire with standard BYO-HSM answers and mark the 7-day rotation as "requires compliance exception; justification attached."
sam_sre: Will ping when firewall rules are ready. If BankX wants on-prem handshake (air-gapped), that'll add ~3-4 days and some SOW language.
alex: Great — I'll loop in sales engineering to prepare the quote and legal for SOW terms. Thanks everyone. :party_parrot:
